Sonam Wangchuk Ultimatum for CJP Leaders' Release

Activist Sonam Wangchuk has issued a 24-hour ultimatum to the government, demanding the release of CJP leaders. Wangchuk stated that if the leaders are not released, he will be compelled to take further action, implying a hunger strike. This comes after the arrest of CJP leaders during a protest in Delhi.
